This is far from the first forum I've spent my time on, and it won't be the last. I've always left forums when they reached the point at which it's mostly assholes and circle jerks, and every successful forum I've ever been on has reached that point sooner or later (though I've never before seen one do that in just a few months).

The thing that the last couple of months on Voat has proven to me is that the mere existence of up and downvoting accelerates that process.

It's not that the forum goes to shit because of the mechanics of up and downvoting - it's the mere existence of it. That is to say, it's not the fact that some posts and threads are upvoted and some are downvoted and some rise and some fall and so on. It's that the mere existence of up and downvotes gives reactionary, intolerant assholes something to rally around. The mere ability to crash around the site downvoting other people just means that the site self-selects for the kind of people who want to crash around downvoting other people. It's a mechanism that's most attractive to assholes, and I want to avoid assholes, so it's a mechanism I'm going to avoid in the future.

So... when I find a good forum that's threaded (I don't like flat forums) and that doesn't have up and downvoting, and that has a community that's large enough to be interesting but not so large that trolls and idiots are overrepresented, that's where I'm going to go next. And that's where I'll be until it goes to shit, which it will, sooner or later, because the assholes always show up sooner or later.
